answer_1.quote: Cross-Lingual Summarization (XLS) aims at generating a summary in the target language from a given document in a different source language.
answer_1.outputs: summaries in the target language from source-language dialogues

answer_2.quote: Four automatic metrics are adopted in our experiments: ROUGE-1 (R1) and ROUGE-2 (R2) evaluate unigram and bigram overlap between the generated summaries and corresponding references, respectively. ROUGE-L (R-L) is applied to find the length of the longest common subsequence. BERTScore (B-S) evaluates the semantic similarity of generated sentences against the references.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human studies to further evaluate the performances of the strong baselines under each paradigm and our pre-trained model... Seven crowd workers with high levels of fluency in English and Chinese are asked to assess the generated Chinese summaries from three aspects: grammaticality (Gram.), informativeness (Info.) and conciseness (Conci.).
answer_4.guideline: Following the Best-Worst Scaling method, crowd workers are asked to select the best and the worst generated summaries on each criteria.
